name: Shanghai Beite Technology group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Beite Technology group Co., Ltd. engages in the chassis components, lightweight aluminum alloy, and air-conditioning compressor businesses in China. The company provides chassis-related racks, gears, torsion bars, worm gears, input shafts, output shafts, IPA assemblies, shock absorber piston rods, differential output shafts, new energy high-precision parts CDC-evo external control valve housings, and CDC-ivo internal control valve components, as well as IPB intelligent integrated braking components, such as Flange and Piston.
